texts.preamble: Gujarat Co-Operative Milk Marketing ... vs Adjudicating Officer/Joint ... on 5 November, 2020 Bench: Nitin Jamdar, Milind N. Jadhav 25. os wpl 56 R.M. Amberkar (Private Secretary) In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay O.O.C.J. Writ Petition (L) No. 5673 Of 2020 Gujarat Co-operative Milk Marketing Federation Ltd .. Petitioner
texts.facts: Second that pursuant to the impugned order dated 21 July Gujarat Co-Operative Milk Marketing ... vs Adjudicating Officer/Joint ... on 5 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155508897/ 1 2020, Respondents - State Authorities be restrained from taking any further coercive steps. 4. As regards the first ad-interim relief is concerned, learned AGP, on instructions, states that since the Petitioner did not take steps to sell the goods in question as per the impugned orders which were passed in July 2020 within a time limit of four weeks specified therein and that the goods are perishable, the State Government has already issued notices and tenders have been received and the auction is to be conducted in this week.
